capacity.inference_note: Primary percentile bootstrap intervals and centered-bootstrap p-values treat disjoint semantic families as the finite-benchmark estimation units and Holm correction covers eight registered sparse-design effects. A separate intent-cluster analysis averages semantic variants within each of the twelve fixed intent templates and is reported as a conservative sensitivity analysis. The second harness is a stratified robustness diagnostic and is not pooled into primary effects.

routing_policy_robustness.interpretation: Positive success differences favor the fixed full-menu policy. Positive work differences mean the fixed policy consumed more resources. This robustness layer is descriptive and is excluded from the Holm family.

discovery.interaction_orientation: (hierarchical R2048-R32) minus (flat R2048-R32); positive values mean hierarchical retrieval attenuates registered-load loss

retained_itt_infrastructure_sensitivity.policy: score every retained ITT infrastructure row as a verified success and recompute the registered family-mean contrasts; nothing else changes
